title: Tenant-aware feature flags for login policy
name: Login policy flags

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code decides whether a flag is on for a given user? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A tenant appears in both `allowTenants` and `denyTenants` for an enabled flag. What does isEnabled return for its users?
choices: true, because allow is checked against the rollout first
It depends on the user's bucket
false, because the deny list is checked before the allow list

questions.prompt: Why does bucketFor hash `${flagKey}:${userId}` rather than just the userId?
choices: So that the same users are not always the early cohort for every flag at a given percentage
So that a user's bucket changes on each login
To make the hash cheaper to compute
So that tenants are bucketed instead of users

questions.prompt: A user has a password, no WebAuthn, and TOTP enrolled; `require-mfa-enrollment` is on for them. What is the outcome?
